import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
output = Path('products/services/catalogue-training-license/director-exercise-rehearsal.json')
verifiers = sorted(site.rglob('verify_example.py'))
result = {'scope': 'Offline rehearsal of existing files on a synthetic catalogue. Shopify import and customer delivery are unverified.', 'verifier_candidates': [str(path) for path in verifiers]}
if len(verifiers) == 1:
    verifier = verifiers[0]
    command = [sys.executable, verifier.name]
    completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=verifier.parent, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=False)
    result.update(command=['python3', verifier.name], cwd=str(verifier.parent), verifier_sha256=hashlib.sha256(verifier.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), exit_code=completed.returncode, stdout=completed.stdout, stderr=completed.stderr)
else:
    result['status'] = 'Expected exactly one verifier in the selected release directory. No execution attempted.'
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
